extracted_from: Swiss Re, through its subsidiary Swiss Re Insurance-Linked Investment Advisors Corporation (“SRILIAC”), has been appointed as co-investment manager of GAM’s ILS fund range, including the GAM Star Cat Bond UCITS Fund, effective from 7 May 2025.
extraction_notes: No se encontraron nombres de gestores individuales; solo se identifica a Swiss Re Insurance-Linked Investment Advisors Corporation (SRILIAC) como co-gestor de inversiones responsable de las decisiones de inversión y gestión de cartera para el fondo objetivo, a partir del 7 de mayo de 2025.
